profiled_request_memory.scope: Allocator fluctuation during short profiled requests; activation and temporary workspace remain combined without allocation attribution
profiled_request_memory.workspace_limit: No separately typed WORKSPACE records or named allocations means independent workspace peak is unknown. The window max-minus-min PTA envelope only bounds any incremental workspace within those recorded PTA allocations; persistent baseline or untracked allocations are outside this bound.
profiled_request_memory.component_relation: PTA+GE is composite; APP/PTA/GE/PTA+GE totals must not be added together
